description: Create a new cryptocurrency exchange/swap transaction on Flashift.

amount.description: Amount of source currency to exchange (greater than 0).

fixed.description: Whether the rate is fixed (true) or floating (false).

provider_name.description: Name of the exchange provider chosen from get_estimated_amount (e.g. changenow).

to_address.description: Destination wallet address where swapped funds will be received.

to_extra_id.description: Memo, destination tag, or extra ID if required by the target currency/network (e.g. XRP, TON, XLM).

user_id.description: Optional affiliate or user ID for tracking the transaction.

name: create_transaction
title: Create Transaction
